name: Beggin'
_note: Prefix matching: unquoted 'beg' should match the token 'beggin''. Also shows that a trailing apostrophe is part of the token, so quoted "beggin" (no apostrophe) will NOT exact-match "beggin'" -- a real quirk worth knowing about, not something the tests should silently paper over.

name: Beg for You (feat. Rina Sawayama)
_note: Exact quoted match: "beg" should match the standalone word 'beg' here (no trailing apostrophe), unlike Beggin'. Also covers: punctuation touching a match word ('you (' / 'you)'), a repeated 3-word phrase for matchCount (>1), case-insensitivity ('Beg' vs query 'beg'), a multi-artist song, and playlist membership (one playlist).

name: petal
_note: Four things at once: (1) 'again' / 'They' sit on either side of a line break -- query 'again they' should still match. (2) 'I don't need someone to save me' is a NEGATIVE case: query 'need to save' must NOT match, since 'someone' sits between 'need' and 'to save' (word-order/adjacency is required, not just word presence). (3) 'Heartbreak won't bite' and 'Petal in the pavement' each appear twice -- matchCount should reflect that. (4) The title 'petal' ALSO appears inside the lyrics ('Petal in the pavement') -- query 'petal' should sum matches from both title and lyrics, and the returned snippet should come from the lyrics, not the title (per lyricMatches[0] ?? titleMatches[0]).

name: POP GIRL (with BAYLI & Isabella Lovestory)
_note: Covers: comma directly touching a match word ('clear,'), case-insensitivity ('Skin' vs query 'skin'), a hyphen acting as a word separator ('Iced-out' -> query 'iced out' should match), a repeated phrase for matchCount, a numeric token ('2012' is a searchable word), overlapping sliding-window matches ('pop-pop-pop' -> 3 consecutive 'pop' tokens, so query 'pop pop' should produce 2 overlapping matches), a 3-artist song, and a combined-filter case -- playlist='cover of vogue' AND artist='BAYLI' AND album='POP GIRLS CLUB' should all be satisfiable together on this one track.

name: FIND GOD (feat. Dominic Fike)
_note: Lyrics are null (real track where LRCLIB had no match) -- this should still be findable via a TITLE-only match, e.g. query 'find god'. Also: artist filter should match on the SECOND artist ('Dominic Fike'), not just the first.

name: Dog Days Are Over
_note: liked:false -- should be EXCLUDED when scope='liked', but INCLUDED when playlist='dog days' (its actual playlist) or scope='spotify' (no restriction). Also a real artist name with punctuation ('Florence + The Machine') for the artist filter.

name: Get Up
_note: DECOY -- deliberately shares no vocabulary with any of the other fixtures' test queries (beg, love, dog days, pop, skin, iced, petal, paradise, god, etc). Exists purely as a negative control: it should never appear in results for any of the other test cases' queries, catching a filter bug that accidentally returns everything.
